events.text:
Objetivo observado

Observação: Confirmed reservation at Willow for 'Quarterly planning' tomorrow 10:00–11:00, for 12 people with projector included, reservation total $245 all charges included (CAD), reservation code visible on confirmation (evidence #17). Review before confirming showed the same details and breakdown $235 room + $0 projector + $10 service (evidence #15).

Interpretação simulada: The persona goal was met within budget: Willow satisfied capacity (12), projector, one-hour slot, purpose, and the $250 all-in limit, while Atlas at $280 did not.

Limites: Reservation is stated to be saved only in this browser session for this demo venue; no real payment was taken, as shown on earlier steps. No other rooms or dates were tested.

Capturas indicadas: #3, #7, #15, #17. A correspondência com a evidência requer revisão humana.
events.interpretation: Relato do modelo; capturas e conclusões exigem revisão humana.

findings.title: Willow met all requirements within budget while Atlas exceeded it
findings.observation: Room list showed Atlas at $280 total and Willow at $245 total, both 12 seats with projector (evidence #3 and #7). Confirmation showed Willow booked for Quarterly planning, 12 people, projector included, $245 total (evidence #17).
findings.expected: A suitable room must seat 12, include a projector, and keep the all-in total at or below $250.
findings.expectedSource: Persona's explicit meeting requirements and budget limit in the charter.
findings.personaComment: Willow gave me everything I needed without going over budget.
findings.interpretation: Clear all-in totals on the room cards allowed a budget-compliant choice without later surprises.
findings.uncertainty: Only the two listed rooms and the tomorrow 10:00–11:00 slot were observed.

learnings.content: On the room list, Willow was listed at $245 total ($235 room + $0 projector + $10 service) for 12 seats with projector, while Atlas was $280 total, over a $250 budget.
learnings.subject: Room pricing and suitability
learnings.value: Willow $245 all-in, 12 seats, projector; Atlas $280 all-in
learnings.confidenceBasis: Directly visible on landing and room-list screenshots #3 and #7, and consistent in review #15 and confirmation #17.

screenPatterns: room list cards with total and breakdown

learnings.content: Booking flow proceeds: plan details (date/time/people/projector) -> choose a room -> enter meeting name -> review -> confirm reservation, ending with a confirmed reservation summary.
learnings.subject: Gather booking flow order
learnings.value: Your plans / Choose a room / Your meeting / Review, then confirmation
learnings.confidenceBasis: Step indicators and screens observed at #5, #7, #9, #15 and confirmation at #17 show this sequence in this journey only.

persona.name: Maya · Office coordinator
persona.label: Maya · Office coordinator
persona.context: You organize the team’s quarterly planning meeting. The approved room budget is strict and you are accountable for the complete amount, including equipment and fees.
persona.mission: Book a room for 12 people with a projector for the available one-hour meeting slot. Enter the meeting purpose Quarterly planning. Keep the complete cost at or below $250.
persona.initialKnowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.knowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.constraints: Total spending must not exceed $250. You cannot increase the budget. You need seats for all 12 people and a projector.
persona.skills: Comfortable with ordinary web forms, room descriptions and checking a booking summary.
persona.decision: Choose a suitable room based on the full cost and requirements you can establish from the interface.
persona.resources: Desktop browser and fictional meeting details; no real payment information.
persona.expectations: You expect to understand what you are paying and keep the details you have already entered when changing a choice.
persona.priorities: Budget compliance and suitability first, then avoiding unnecessary repeated work.
persona.successCriteria: A visible confirmed reservation for 12 attendees with a projector, the requested meeting purpose and an all-in total within your own budget. Verify the actual confirmation details.
persona.stopCriteria: Stop after a verified suitable reservation, a supported obstacle after reasonable recovery, or inconclusive navigation. Do not book beyond your budget.

limitations: Synthetic persona observations. Completion is distinct from achieving the goal.

experience.observation: Landing shows Atlas at $280 total and Willow at $245 total, both listed as 12 seats with a projector; Willow's breakdown is $235 room + $0 projector + $10 service.
experience.reaction: Willow looks like the one that keeps me within budget while seating everyone, so I'll pick it.

experience.observation: Form shows Tomorrow, 10:00–11:00, 12 people, and 'We need a projector' checked, with a note 'One hour.'
experience.reaction: These details already match my meeting, so I'll continue to the rooms.

experience.observation: Room list confirms meeting: Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector required. Atlas is $280 total, Willow is $245 total, both 12 seats with projector.
experience.reaction: Willow is the only one within my budget, so that's my choice.

experience.observation: Meeting details page for Willow shows Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector included, $235 + $0 + $10 = $245 total, and an empty Meeting name field.
experience.reaction: The total and details check out, so I'll add my meeting purpose next.

experience.observation: Meeting name field is focused and still empty, with Willow summary showing $245 total on the right.
experience.reaction: I'll enter Quarterly planning exactly as my meeting purpose.

experience.observation: Meeting name now reads 'Quarterly planning' and the Willow summary still shows 12 people, projector included, $245 total.
experience.reaction: Good, my purpose is in and the price hasn't changed, so I'll check the review.

experience.observation: Review shows meeting name Quarterly planning, seating for 12 and a projector, Willow Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, with $235 + $0 + $10 = $245 total, all charges included.
experience.reaction: Everything matches my requirements and stays under budget, so I'll confirm.

charterSnapshot.name: Book a room that fits
charterSnapshot.mission: Explore Gather from the selected persona’s point of view and reserve a room satisfying their meeting requirements and spending limit. Verify the final reservation details. Report uncertainty, lost work and meaningful experience moments as they occur.
charterSnapshot.scope: Commercial landing page through room selection, details, review and confirmed reservation, including reasonable recovery when a choice does not fit.
charterSnapshot.successCriteria: The visible saved reservation matches the persona’s purpose, capacity, projector requirement and all-in budget. Describe any remaining incompleteness precisely.
charterSnapshot.stopCriteria: A verified reservation, an observed obstacle after reasonable recovery, unsafe action or the session limits.
charterSnapshot.startingState: First visit in a new independent browser session, with no prior reservation or product knowledge.
charterSnapshot.goals: Complete one suitable test reservation and verify its details. Do not confuse a successful action with accomplishing the persona’s goal.
charterSnapshot.expectedBehaviorSources: The persona’s explicit meeting requirements, product-visible prices and requirements, and actual recorded confirmation. Preserve factual prices, room capacities and existing successful booking paths when evaluating changes.
charterSnapshot.allowedActions: Use dedicated test data within the environment policy.
